meta.description: Machine-readable rule catalog for the StreamCurves regional-model methodology. Each rule carries a threshold_status (provisional | calibrated | approved) and an implementation_status (implemented | partial | not_yet_implemented) mapped to the real StreamCurves code, so the catalog never claims the app does something it does not. Thresholds mirror config/methodology_config.yaml; prose lives in ../methodology.md. v0.3 recalibrated the DATA sample-size floors on the two pilots' real EASI-screened reference sizes (NH-58=33 Functioning, ECBP-55=0 Functioning/16 best-available) and the regional_agent now enforces them.

threshold_status.provisional: Operating default, not yet calibrated. Never describe as validated.
threshold_status.calibrated: Adjusted using the pilot ecoregions or other validation data.
threshold_status.approved: Formally accepted by the scientific team for operational use.

implementation_status.implemented: A real StreamCurves function performs this today (see maps_to).
implementation_status.partial: Related machinery exists but diverges from the rule as written (see note).
implementation_status.not_yet_implemented: Specified here; no code performs it yet. Route affected decisions to human review.

rules.name: Missing observations (auto)
rules.purpose: Gate variables with acceptable missingness into automated analysis.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/precheck.py (flag_low_n / missingness flags)
rules.note: Precheck flags missingness but the 0.20 cutoff is not the wired action threshold today.

rules.name: Moderate missingness
rules.purpose: Analyze-with-caution band for partial coverage.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/precheck.py

rules.name: High missingness
rules.purpose: Prevent auto-recommendation on sparse coverage.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/precheck.py

rules.name: Minimum unstratified sample
rules.purpose: Floor for automated curve evaluation.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/regional_agent.py MIN_N_AUTO (sample_size_disposition); curves.py hard floor n<5
rules.note: Calibrated v0.3 from 50 -> 20 on the pilots' real reference sizes (IQR quartiles are stable near n=20). regional_agent flags every curve below this as exploratory/insufficient.

rules.name: Exploratory unstratified sample
rules.purpose: Exploratory-only band.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/regional_agent.py MIN_N_EXPLORATORY (sample_size_disposition)
rules.note: Calibrated v0.3 from [30,50) to [10,20). Curves in this band publish as preliminary but carry an 'exploratory' flag and a confidence cap; certification requires human approval.

outcomes.review: exploratory: flag + confidence cap, preliminary only unless approved

rules.name: Insufficient unstratified sample
rules.purpose: Do not auto-fit below this floor.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/regional_agent.py MIN_N_FLOOR; curves.py (n<5 -> insufficient_data); run_state CURVE_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT
rules.note: Calibrated v0.3 from 30 to 10. 5 <= n < 10 builds but is flagged 'insufficient' for mandatory review; n < 5 is the engine's hard insufficient_data.

rules.name: Minimum sample per stratum
rules.purpose: Floor for automated stratified evaluation.
rules.maps_to: config/stratification_registry.yaml min_group_size (default 5); feasibility.py
rules.note: Calibrated v0.3 from 30 to 15. Not exercised in the v1 agent (no stratification yet).
rules.confidence_effect: cap 59 per stratum if below minimum

rules.name: Very small stratum
rules.purpose: Reject automatic stratification on thin groups.
rules.maps_to: feasibility.py (sparse-cell detection); run_state CURVE_STATUS_STRAT_REVIEW

outcomes.review: reject auto-stratification unless externally defined + approved

rules.name: Repeated observations (grouped folds)
rules.purpose: Prevent leakage: one site cannot appear in both train and test folds.
rules.maps_to: net-new (no CV in code; bundled NRSA is one-row-per-site, so no revisits exist yet)
rules.note: Moot on current data (de-duplicated to one row per site) but required before any revisit or multi-year data is used.

rules.name: Strong pairwise association
rules.purpose: Flag strong empirical redundancy between two metrics.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/cross_metric.py (computes Pearson + Spearman; flags on |Pearson| > 0.80)
rules.note: DIVERGENCE: code flags on |Pearson|>0.80; methodology primary flag is |Spearman|>=0.80. Switch the flag column to reach implemented.

outcomes.fail: strong redundancy flag -> evaluate function overlap (RED matrix)

rules.name: Moderate pairwise association
rules.purpose: Investigate function overlap and stability.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/cross_metric.py (correlations computed; moderate-band action net-new)

rules.name: Low pairwise association
rules.purpose: Not redundant on correlation alone.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/cross_metric.py

outcomes.pass: retain as distinct if otherwise eligible

rules.name: Multicollinearity review
rules.purpose: Review a proposed multimetric set for collinearity.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/diagnostics.py::_car_vif (caution band 5-10)

rules.name: Severe multicollinearity
rules.purpose: Do not retain the combination without justification.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/diagnostics.py::_car_vif (fail band >=10)

rules.name: Stability of redundancy classification
rules.purpose: Redundancy category should be stable across resamples.
rules.test: same category in >= 80% of bootstrap resamples
rules.maps_to: net-new (no bootstrap in code)

rules.name: Multiple testing (redundancy)
rules.purpose: Control false discovery across many association tests.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/screening.py (statsmodels multipletests BH, used for stratifier screening)
rules.note: BH-FDR exists for stratifier screening; applying it to the pairwise redundancy matrix is net-new.

rules.name: Existing stratifier screen (KW + effect + feasibility)
rules.purpose: Current operational gate for choosing a stratifier per metric.
rules.test: Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon (BH) + effect size + feasibility + composite score
rules.threshold: composite score, one stratifier per metric
rules.maps_to: screening.py, effects.py, consistency.py, feasibility.py, decision.py::make_stratification_decisions
rules.confidence_effect: decision.total_score (0-1) is the current numeric proxy

rules.name: CV error improvement (minimum)
rules.purpose: Minimum cross-validated evidence supporting stratification.
rules.test: >= 10% reduction in CV RMSE or MAE
rules.maps_to: net-new (no CV / RMSE / MAE in code)

rules.name: CV error improvement (strong)
rules.purpose: Strong cross-validated evidence.
rules.test: >= 15% reduction in CV RMSE or MAE
rules.maps_to: net-new

rules.name: Change in CV explained variation
rules.purpose: Supporting evidence via delta R-squared.
rules.maps_to: net-new (models.py reports in-sample adj-R2, not CV R2)

rules.name: Information criterion (AICc)
rules.purpose: Supporting IC evidence.
rules.maps_to: net-new (models.py uses BIC, not AICc; BIC could serve as a documented proxy)

rules.name: Information criterion (strong)
rules.purpose: Strong IC evidence.
rules.maps_to: net-new (BIC proxy available)

rules.name: Resampling stability
rules.purpose: Improvement should recur across resamples.
rules.maps_to: net-new (no bootstrap); consistency.py measures cross-metric stability, not resample stability

rules.name: Breakpoint stability
rules.purpose: Reproducible continuous stratification.
rules.test: estimated split in same approved interval in >= 70% of resamples
rules.maps_to: net-new (no data-derived breakpoint estimation; DACAT bins are pre-defined)

rules.name: Maximum data-derived bins
rules.purpose: Limit data-derived stratum count.
rules.maps_to: config/stratification_registry.yaml (DACAT is 3 pre-defined categories; no data-derived binning today)

outcomes.review: more than 3 -> strong rationale + human approval

rules.name: Group-difference test
rules.purpose: Supporting evidence that curves differ by group.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/screening.py (Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon + BH)

rules.name: Model family on approved list
rules.purpose: Only approved curve families may be fit.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/curves.py::build_reference_curve (the sole Approved family)

rules.name: Out-of-sample validation
rules.purpose: Grouped cross-validation completed before automated acceptance.
rules.maps_to: net-new (no CV). Current acceptance is geometric validation (CURVE-07a).

rules.name: Parsimony (one standard error)
rules.purpose: Choose the simplest model within 1 SE of best validated performance.
rules.maps_to: net-new (single family today, so moot until multiple families exist)

rules.name: Influence sensitivity
rules.purpose: Mandatory review if one influential point moves a key parameter or the decision.
rules.test: drop-one changes key parameter by > 20% or flips the decision
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/diagnostics.py (Cook's distance on regression models, not wired to curve auto-review)

rules.name: Direction or shape conflict
rules.purpose: Do not silently override an approved ecological expectation.
rules.test: estimated direction conflicts with approved expectation
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/curves.py (higher_is_better inversion + degenerate detection); expected-shape input not stored
rules.note: Direction is handled by inversion, but there is no stored per-metric expected-shape to check against (Unresolved Input 3).

rules.name: Uncertainty reported
rules.purpose: Confidence or prediction intervals must be reported.
rules.maps_to: net-new for IQR curves (regional.py has a 95% CI for the separate power-law feature only)

rules.name: Residual structure
rules.purpose: No meaningful systematic residual pattern remains.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/diagnostics.py (Shapiro / Breusch-Pagan on regression, not on the IQR curve)

rules.name: Geometric validation (current acceptance gate)
rules.purpose: The IQR-seed curve must validate geometrically.
rules.test: >=2 points; metric non-decreasing; index in [0,1]; spans 0.30 and 0.70; <=2 crossings of each band
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/curves.py::validate_reference_curve_points

rules.name: Reproducibility
rules.purpose: Same inputs + seed + method version reproduce the curve.
rules.maps_to: streamcurves/curves.py (deterministic numpy/pandas); run_state method-version stamps; library.py content_digest

rules.name: Primary reference tier (least-disturbed)
rules.purpose: Default reference population = Functioning sites.
rules.maps_to: _vendor/easi/batch/qualify.PRESETS['functional']; easi_screening.SCREENING_PRESET_CHOICES (default)
rules.confidence_effect: no cap; least-disturbed reference can score High

rules.name: Reference-tier fallback (best-available)
rules.purpose: When the Functioning-only pool is too small, include Functioning-at-Risk sites, explicitly and under review.
rules.test: IF least-disturbed pool fails DATA-04/DATA-06 for a metric or stratum THEN switch to at_risk_or_better (ECI > 0.39)
rules.maps_to: _vendor/easi/batch/qualify.PRESETS['at_risk_or_better'] (preset exists; the fallback trigger + provenance stamp + confidence cap are net-new policy/automation)
rules.note: Reconciles with revision_plan 'never relax the ECI threshold': that forbade SILENT/AUTOMATIC weakening to chase sample size. REF-02 is explicit, reviewed, provenance-stamped, confidence-capped, and user-authorized. Shifts the baseline from least-disturbed to best-available reference (degraded-baseline bias risk).

outcomes.review: MANDATORY human review of every affected curve

rules.confidence_effect: cap 59 (best_available_reference); mandatory review; stamp reference_tier per curve + bundle

rules.name: Reference floor
rules.purpose: Never build reference curves from below Functioning-at-Risk.
rules.test: reference tier in {least_disturbed, best_available}; never all_sites
rules.maps_to: easi_screening.SCREENING_PRESET_CHOICES (all_sites offered for exploration, not for reference curves, by policy)

outcomes.fail: block: all_sites is not a reference pool

rules.name: 0-100 confidence score
rules.purpose: Workflow-triage score for every decision.
rules.test: weighted sum of six components (see config confidence_rules.components)
rules.maps_to: net-new (current triage is categorical: run_state curve statuses + boolean needs_review)

rules.name: Confidence caps
rules.purpose: Hard caps regardless of subtotal.
rules.test: apply caps: 59 (no ecology / no OOS validation / below min n / best-available reference); 39 (leakage/circularity)
rules.maps_to: net-new (ties to REF-02, DATA-04/09, CURVE-02/05)

rules.name: Compact portfolio size
rules.purpose: One primary metric per function; at most one complementary secondary.
rules.maps_to: views/summary_state.eligible_summary_metrics + run_state intended_metrics_for_publish (scope exists; the 100-point metric score is net-new)
rules.note: The NH pilot already carries two metrics for Nutrient cycling and three for Community dynamics; three requires explicit human approval under this rule.
rules.confidence_effect: metric_score ranks candidates within a function

rules.name: 100-point metric score
rules.purpose: Rank candidates within a function (not an automatic decision).
rules.maps_to: net-new (no metric score in code)
